popover.notes: Speech-bubble card; optional action icons (e.g. chevrons)

tutorial.notes: Spotlight tour; Escape priority 110; wraps initPopover

combobox.notes: Multi via data-combobox-multi; multi also uses badge

color-input.notes: Optional openOnClick nests/uses color-set and color-picker (keep those components when using open hooks)

color-picker.notes: Uses slider for RGB/CMYK/alpha channels; optional adjacent colour set via color-set

charts.notes: Thin mountChart host; pages need an import map for d3-scale / d3-shape when using barY / barX
